newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Monday conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money market at 3.25 percent, dealers said.

The central bank intervened after the call loan or overnight lending rate traded at the top of its 2.75-3.25 percent target range for the rate. Dealers said the rate was trading unusually high for a Monday.
"Money is getting a little tight so they're just telling us they're keeping the range where it is," said a T-bill dealer with one bank-owned brokerage.
The call loan rate remained bid at 3.25 percent in the wake of the intervention, the dealer said. The three-month when-issued T-bill traded at 3.25 percent in the wake of the intervention.
